summary.text: Beth Cacciotti is the Democratic candidate for the New Hampshire House of Representatives, Rockingham 18, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Ballotpedia's campaign-finance listing records that Beth Cacciotti lost the 2018 general election for New Hampshire House of Representatives Rockingham 14.
